avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I use this to double cleanse, before using my prescription face wash, and it has made a noticeable difference vs. using the Rx alone. First, a little bit goes a long, long way. It is lightweight and not filmy. I've been using this for about 2 months and I've got so much product left. It lathers well and takes off make up easily (a little extra pressure for mascara, though!), and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. For complete transparency, I won't say that it doesn't make my eyes feel irritated, because it can, sometimes, but it is brief and manageable and stops as soon as I rinse and dry my face. I've used other products that left my eyes stinging for a bit. This is worth the brief discomfort. The packaging doesn't take up a lot of space and I like that the lid has a dedicated space for the spatula, which keeps it from getting thrown away and the spatula makes it easy to take however much product you want.
